goal: Continue suzume's wave-by-wave WPT improvement (post-Wave 135 baseline) by shipping 3-5 narrowly-scoped, spec-cited waves that add subtests without regressing the Node-contains 1482/1482 and Node-compareDocumentPosition 1444/1444 canaries.
constraints: Every fix cites a WHATWG DOM / HTML / Selectors / WebIDL spec section.
No WPT-specific hacks; logic must generalize.
Canary regression (Node-contains, Node-compareDocumentPosition) is non-negotiable — block immediately.
Do NOT widen parentNode own-property to lexbor-backed Element/PI/Comment (Wave 130/134 constraint).
All wpt-mode measurements run sequentially (parallel runs cause silent OOM on 4GB VPS).
Each wave = 1 narrowly-scoped theme = 1-2 commits + wave{N}-final tag.
Commit message: feat(forms|kotori|dom): <summary> (Wave N) with Co-Authored-By footer.
